sections.title: Create a driver account
sections.content: ## Steps ### Step 1 Go to the **Account** module → open the **Users** menu → click the New button ![](/uploads/65a44f06f6d9d670b06bc35f.png) ![](/uploads/2577480ec389aca49c4ad17d.png) ### Step 2 Enter the login information * Name: enter the driver's name * Email Address: enter the driver's phone number (this is the phone number the driver uses to sign in to the mobile app) * User Group: defaults to "Container" * Is Driver: check this field if this is a driver account ![](/uploads/1ca615f786affe1867dcefdb.png) ### Step 3 Click **Add a line** → find and select the "Driver" role ![](/uploads/8063d6a03a1510de340e71e0.png) ![](/uploads/64ef2225b11bf7a17a05cd4d.png) ![](/uploads/1ae9a59da47fae6d4e1921e8.png) ### Step 4 Click the Save button, or press CTRL + S, or click the manual-save indicator to finish creating the account. ![](/uploads/81b08df0961c92151776da9e.png) ### Step 5 Set an initial password for the account * Click the action button → select "Change Password": ![](/uploads/44fdf856fc9cccb6a6ffad9c.png) * The change-password popup appears → enter the new password in the "**New Password**" field and click **CHANGE PASSWORD** ![](/uploads/e816516e29f306b6378c58dc.png) → The driver account has been created. The driver will sign in to the mobile app using this phone number and the password just set. ### Step 6 The user administrator notifies the dispatch department that the driver account has been created. The dispatcher then goes to the system, opens the **Driver** menu, and fills in the driver's personal information. ![](/uploads/07159faab7eb2c9b7cb50947.png) ![](/uploads/95d0166bf5d49017df194261.png)

sections.title: Create a dispatcher account
sections.content: ## Steps ### Step 1 Go to the **Settings** module → open the **Users** menu → click the New button ![](/uploads/65a44f06f6d9d670b06bc35f.png) ![](/uploads/2577480ec389aca49c4ad17d.png) ### Step 2 Enter the login information * Name: enter the dispatcher's name * Email Address: enter the dispatcher's company email * User Group: defaults to "Container" * Is Driver: do **NOT** check this field ![](/uploads/64b2377307cf9cd979990d46.png) ### Step 3 Click **Add a line** → find and select the "**Dispatcher**" role ![](/uploads/f16e92911f4e8810b092f372.png) ![](/uploads/b958b26990deefe5299ad50f.png) ### Step 4 Click the Save button, or press CTRL + S, to finish creating the account. ![](/uploads/b1f91aed539a21344d673844.png) ### Step 5 Set an initial password for the account * Click the action button → select "Change Password": ![](/uploads/44fdf856fc9cccb6a6ffad9c.png) * The change-password popup appears → enter the new password in the "**New Password**" field and click **CHANGE PASSWORD** ![](/uploads/e816516e29f306b6378c58dc.png) → The dispatcher account has been created.

sections.title: Driver changes phone number
sections.content:
## Steps

### Step 1

Go to the **Account** module → open the **Users** menu → click the driver account whose phone number needs to change

### Step 2

Enter the new phone number in the **Email Address** field

![](/uploads/04c13aae1b3bcccc505929ff.png)

### Step 3

Click SAVE, or press CTRL + S, to finish

![](/uploads/006e23e16859a37ab5502274.png)

sections.title: Change account password
sections.content: ## Steps ### Step 1 Open the account whose password needs to change → click the action button → Change Password ![](/uploads/44fdf856fc9cccb6a6ffad9c.png) * The change-password popup appears → enter the new password in the "**New Password**" field and click **CHANGE PASSWORD** ![](/uploads/e816516e29f306b6378c58dc.png)

sections.title: Archive an account
sections.content: For accounts that are no longer used — for example a driver or dispatcher who has left the company — the account should be archived. ## Steps ### Step 1 Open the account to archive → click the icon → click "Archive" ![](/uploads/046e4f43a2c7377828f01f8f.png) ### Step 2 The system asks for confirmation → if you're sure, click **ARCHIVE** ![](/uploads/356f57ba02cc67855f553e8c.png) ![](/uploads/0f84902bce1668fd3c97af83.png)

sections.title: Delete an account
sections.content: Use this when an account needs to be deleted — for example, a duplicate or a mistakenly created account. ## Steps ### Step 1 Open the account to delete → click the icon → click "Delete" ![](/uploads/82338b158b5b34b5e241eae4.png) ### Step 2 The system asks for confirmation → click OK to confirm ![](/uploads/1b77bde4295e80060e6d802c.png)
